roles.name: line
roles.doc: Decorative separators and card borders; interactive boundaries use line-strong.

roles.name: danger-soft
roles.doc: Error containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: success-soft
roles.doc: Success containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: warning-soft
roles.doc: Warning containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: line-strong
roles.doc: Interactive boundaries: editor borders and control outlines.

roles.name: selection
roles.doc: Selected-text background; derived from the accent when a pack omits it.

roles.name: shadow
roles.doc: Elevation shadow ink; `shadow-*` layers take it at their alpha.

frame.doc: Every message the core hands a platform adapter: the presented frame snapshot, semantic nodes, automation exchanges, input-protocol replies and the text menu. Type grammar: string, bool, u8, u32, u64, i64, usize, f32, f64, any; T? may be absent or null; T[] is a list; T[n] a fixed list; other names refer to types below.

viewport.doc: The page surface in logical pixels.

insets.type: Readonly<{ top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number }>
insets.doc: System bars and host chrome over the surface, logical pixels.

pointer.doc: `fine` pointers (mouse, trackpad) hover; `coarse` ones (touch) do not.

formFactor.doc: `phone` or `tablet` from the smallest screen width; other hosts may report their own.

sizeClass.doc: `compact` below 600 logical pixels of page width, else `regular`.

reducedMotion.doc: The system asks for reduced motion; `motion-reduce:`/`motion-safe:` follow it.

highContrast.doc: The system asks for increased contrast; the palette resolves its high-contrast variant.

animatorDurationScale.doc: The platform's animation duration multiplier (0..10, default 1); 0 also sets `reducedMotion`.

canDock.doc: Whether the window can dock an `as: 'aside'` beside the main; false until the host reports it.

renderer.doc: `fallback: "driver"` when this device's GPU driver failed and pages render on the CPU.

palette.doc: The resolved theme: `{ revision, colors }`, one #rrggbbaa per role slot; the page never sees it.
